policy: No browser persistence backend and no localStorage or IndexedDB dependency

behavior.java.io.File: Path parsing, comparison, and identity are deterministic. Filesystem queries report absent resources; mutations return false or throw an explicit unsupported IOException.
behavior.fileStreams: Construction throws FileNotFoundException because this profile has no browser filesystem.
behavior.objectSerialization: Primitive ObjectInput/ObjectOutput operations delegate to data streams; readObject and writeObject throw NotSerializableException.
behavior.pipedStreams: Operations throw IOException because blocking thread pipes do not map to J2CL's browser execution model.
behavior.characterDecoding: InputStreamReader buffers its input and decodes with J2CL's built-in EmulatedCharset implementations.

deferred: java.io.File.toPath() until the java-nio-j2cl patch is composed
java.io.File.toURI() until java.net.URI ownership is agreed with WebAWT
